heading: Optional pathway casebook
exactSourceText: The casebook applies the same reasoning to other pathways, each through published experiments. First ask what was measured: a sequence change, an RNA program, a protein state or a functional response. Then ask which direction the finding implies and whether that direction was tested. Finally, separate an active process from one the cancer cells need to survive. Read the four in order, or choose the one that fits your question; together they take about 47 minutes.
